name: Kojima Neneko
source:
[url=/c95232]Mikado's[/url] childhood friend and [url=/c22134]Arisu's older sister[/url]. She loves working at the café her parents own and is a very kind and gentle elder sister. She doesn't approve of Mikado's desire to create a [url=/v5932]Mecha-con[/url] and tries to make him give up his dream until her sister Arisu forces her hand.

Term of endearment for her [url=/c95232]husband[/url] 'Anata' ('You'/Japanese equivalent of 'darling').
